description: This file implements high-performance GPU-accelerated matrix multiplication routines with various scaling schemes tailored for FP8 and other low-precision formats. It includes functions for scaled GEMM operations, handling different tensor layouts, scaling types (tensorwise, rowwise, blockwise), and specific support for AMD's ROCm platform and NVIDIA's CUDA platform. The code manages intricate scaling schemes, type checks, and compatibility validations, integrating advanced GPU features for efficient low-precision matrix computations.
